## Import Object

```{r}

o <- readRDS(file.path(here(), 
                  "Ghasemi_analysis", 
                  "results", 
                  "combined",
                  "malignant_base_before_reintegration.rds"))

```


```{r}

sc_list <- list()
membership_list <- list()

for (s in unique(o$sample)) {
  obj <- subset(x = o, subset = o$sample == s)
  sample_id <- s
  norm <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
  raw  <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")

  scell <- SCimplify(norm, 
                     k.knn = 5, 
                     gamma = 10, 
                     n.var.genes = 2000,
                     n.pc = 10,
                     return_membership = TRUE, 
                     verbose = FALSE)
  
  membership_list[[s]] <- scell$membership
  
  # Sum RAW counts
  SC.counts <- supercell_GE(raw, groups = scell$membership, mode = "sum")

  # supercell_GE returns columns in order 1..N supercells
  sc_ids <- seq_len(ncol(SC.counts))
  colnames(SC.counts) <- paste0(sample_id, "_SC", sc_ids)

  # Majority cell type + size per supercell
  meta <- data.frame(ct = obj$cell_type[names(scell$membership)],
                   sc = scell$membership) |>
  dplyr::group_by(sc) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    cell_type = names(which.max(table(ct))),
    sc_size   = dplyr::n(),
    purity    = max(table(ct)) / dplyr::n()
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()
  rownames(meta) <- paste0(sample_id, "_SC", meta$sc)
  meta$pt_id <- sample_id
  meta$dataset <- "Ghasemi"

  so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = SC.counts, meta.data = meta[colnames(SC.counts), ])
  sc_list[[sample_id]] <- so
  saveRDS(so, file.path(mainDir, paste0(sample_id, "_res"), paste0(sample_id, "_scObject.rds")),
          compress = "xz")
  
}

merged <- merge(sc_list[[1]], sc_list[-1])
merged <- NormalizeData(merged) |> FindVariableFeatures() |> ScaleData() |> RunPCA()
merged <- RunHarmony(
  merged,
  group.by.vars = "pt_id",
  theta = 2
)

ndim <- 20
  
merged <- FindNeighbors(
    merged,
    reduction = "harmony",
    dims = 1:ndim
)
  
merged <- FindClusters(
    merged,
    resolution = 0.26,
    random.seed = 20200204
)
  
merged <- RunUMAP(
    merged,
    reduction = "harmony",
    dims = 1:ndim,
    seed.use = 20200204
  )

# 1. Extract the current embeddings matrix
mat <- Embeddings(merged, reduction = "umap")

# 2. Flip the first column (X-axis)
mat[, 2] <- -1 * mat[, 2]
mat[, 1] <- -1 * mat[, 1]

merged[["umap"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = mat, 
  key = "UMAP_", 
  assay = DefaultAssay(merged)
)

merged@tools$PlotData <- NULL

# 5. Re-plot
DimPlot(merged, reduction = "umap")



combinedDimPlot <- DimPlot(
    merged,
    reduction = "umap",
    group.by = "seurat_clusters"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Ghasemi: All Patients - SC + Harmony") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 5)))
  
ggsave(file.path(here("Ghasemi_analysis", "results", "combined"), "sc_combined_Dim_Plot.png"),
       plot = combinedDimPlot,
       width = 12,
       height = 10,
       bg = "white")

```

```{r}

## CELL -> SUPERCELL LOOKUP

# Cell -> supercell table from membership_list
membership_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(membership_list, function(m, s) {
  data.frame(
    cell   = names(m),
    sample = s,
    sc_id  = paste0(s, "_SC", as.integer(m))   # matches colnames(merged)
  )
})

# Sanity check: do the barcodes match the object on the left plot?
mean(membership_df$cell %in% colnames(without_supercell))
mean(colnames(without_supercell) %in% membership_df$cell)

## ADD SUPERCELL INFO

without_supercell$sc_id <- membership_df$sc_id[
  match(colnames(without_supercell), membership_df$cell)
]

# Pull supercell-level info from the merged SC object
sc_meta <- merged@meta.data[, c("RNA_snn_res.0.26", "sc_size", "purity", "pt_id")]

without_supercell$sc_cluster <- sc_meta[without_supercell$sc_id, "RNA_snn_res.0.26"]
without_supercell$sc_size    <- sc_meta[without_supercell$sc_id, "sc_size"]
without_supercell$sc_purity  <- sc_meta[without_supercell$sc_id, "purity"]

# How do original clusters map to SC clusters?
contingency_matrix <- table(original = without_supercell$RNA_snn_res.0.225,
      sc_cluster = without_supercell$sc_cluster, useNA = "ifany")

prob_matrix <- prop.table(contingency_matrix, margin = 1) * 100

col_order <- c("0", "2", "3", "1", "4", "5")
prob_matrix <- prob_matrix[, col_order]

Heatmap(
  matrix = prob_matrix,
  name = "Matching %",
  col = colorRamp2(c(0, 100), c("#A690A4", "#5E4B56")),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_title = "Cell Cluster Identity",
  column_title = "SuperCell Cluster Identity",
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "gray", width = 2),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
          # grid.text places the text exactly inside each cell
          grid.text(paste0(sprintf("%.1f", prob_matrix[i, j]), "%"), x, y, 
                    gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, col = "white"))}
)
```

## Program Score Concordance (SuperCell v. mean # of member cells)

```{r}

# program specific genes as listed in paper
programs <- list(
  EGL_CGNP    = c("BARHL1", "ZIC1", "ZIC3", "PTPRK"),
  SHH         = c("PTCH1", "SMO", "HHIP", "GLI1", "GLI2"),
  Migrating   = c("GRIN2B", "CNTN2", "ASTN1", "SEMA6A"),
  Postmitotic = c("GABRA1", "GABRA6", "GRIN2C"),
  Astro_like  = c("LAMA2", "SOX2", "SOX9", "BOC")
)

cols <- paste0("prog", seq_along(programs))

score_cor <- list()

for (s in names(sc_list)) {
  obj <- subset(o, subset = sample == s)      # single cells, this sample
  sc  <- NormalizeData(sc_list[[s]])          # supercells, this sample
  mem <- membership_list[[s]]

  # find union of listed programs and all genes in object
  progs <- lapply(programs, intersect, rownames(obj)) 
  
  # calculate module score for single cells and for supercells
  obj <- AddModuleScore(obj, features = progs, name = "prog")
  sc  <- AddModuleScore(sc,  features = progs, name = "prog")

  # mean single-cell score per supercell
  cell_sc <- paste0(s, "_SC", mem)
  member_means <- aggregate(obj@meta.data[names(mem), cols],
                            by = list(sc = cell_sc), FUN = mean)
  member_means <- member_means[match(colnames(sc), member_means$sc), ]

  score_cor[[s]] <- sapply(cols, function(cl)
    cor(sc[[cl]][, 1], member_means[[cl]], use = "complete.obs"))
}

score_cor_df <- do.call(rbind, score_cor)
colnames(score_cor_df) <- names(programs)
score_cor_df

# Heat map to visualize correlation

df_long <- score_cor_df %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Sample, 
    names_to = "Program", 
    values_to = "Value"
  )

sc_ProgramScores <- ggplot(df_long, mapping = aes(x = Program, y = Sample, fill = Value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    limits = c(0.5, 1) # Sets the exact range of the heatmap
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Value, 2)), colour = "white", size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "SuperCell Expression Retention",
    x = "Program",
    y = "Sample",
    fill = "Correlation Score"
  )
  
ggsave(file.path(here(), "Ghasemi_analysis", "results", "combined", "sc_ProgramScores.png"),
       plot = sc_ProgramScores,
       width = 6,
       height = 6,
       bg = "white")
```

## Averaged Heat Map by Cluster of Developmental Marker Genes

```{r}


# Marker genes from the paper, grouped by CGNP stage
stage_genes <- list(
  `Early CGNP (EGL)`   = c("BARHL1", "ZIC1", "ZIC3", "PTPRK"),
  `SHH pathway`        = c("PTCH1", "SMO", "HHIP", "GLI1", "GLI2"),
  `Proliferating/chromatin` = c("EZH2", "SUZ12", "CTCF", "YY1", "RAD21"),
  `Migrating`          = c("GRIN2B", "CNTN2", "ASTN1", "SEMA6A"),
  `Postmitotic`        = c("GABRA1", "GABRA6", "GRIN2C"),
  `Astrocytic-like`    = c("LAMA2", "SOX2", "SOX9", "BOC")
)

objMarkers <- FindAllMarkers(without_supercell, 
                             only.pos = FALSE, 
                             min.pct = 0, 
                             logfc.threshold = 0)

merged <- JoinLayers(merged)          # collapse split layers into one counts and one data
Idents(merged) <- "seurat_clusters"

scMarkers <- FindAllMarkers(merged, 
                            only.pos = FALSE, 
                            min.pct = 0, 
                            logfc.threshold = 0)

pairs <- data.frame(single = c("0","1","2","3","4", "5"),
                    super  = c("0","2","3","1","4", "5"))

res <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) {
  a <- objMarkers[objMarkers$cluster == pairs$single[i], c("gene", "avg_log2FC", "pct.1")]
  b <- scMarkers[scMarkers$cluster == pairs$super[i],  c("gene", "avg_log2FC")]
  m <- merge(a, b, by = "gene", suffixes = c("_single", "_super"))

  # all-gene rank correlation
  rho_all <- cor(m$avg_log2FC_single, m$avg_log2FC_super, method = "spearman")

  # correlation restricted to genes with a real positive effect in either object
  strong <- m$avg_log2FC_single > 0.25 | m$avg_log2FC_super > 0.25
  rho_strong <- cor(m$avg_log2FC_single[strong], m$avg_log2FC_super[strong],
                    method = "spearman")

  # overlap at several depths, filtering out lowly expressed genes in the single-cell list
  a_f <- a[a$pct.1 > 0.25, ]
  ov <- sapply(c(50, 100, 200, 500), function(n) {
    top_single <- head(a_f$gene[order(-a_f$avg_log2FC)], n)
    top_super  <- head(b$gene[order(-b$avg_log2FC)], n)
    length(intersect(top_single, top_super)) / n
  })
  names(ov) <- paste0("top", c(50, 100, 200, 500))

  data.frame(single = pairs$single[i], super = pairs$super[i],
             n_genes = nrow(m), spearman_all = rho_all,
             spearman_strong = rho_strong, t(ov))
})
do.call(rbind, res)

###

avg_heatmap <- function(obj, group_by, title = "") {
  # keep only genes present, and remember which stage each belongs to
  
  gene_df <- data.frame(
  gene  = as.character(unlist(stage_genes, use.names = FALSE)),
  stage = rep(names(stage_genes), lengths(stage_genes))
  )
  
  gene_df <- gene_df[gene_df$gene %in% rownames(obj), ]
  gene_df <- gene_df[!duplicated(gene_df$gene), ]   # one row per gene

  # average expression per cluster (data layer)
  avg <- AverageExpression(
    obj, features = gene_df$gene, group.by = group_by,
    assays = "RNA", layer = "data", return.seurat = FALSE
  )$RNA
  avg <- log1p(as.matrix(avg))        # AverageExpression averages in non-log space

  row_anno <- data.frame(Stage = gene_df$stage, row.names = gene_df$gene)

  pheatmap(
    avg[gene_df$gene, , drop = FALSE],
    scale = "row",                    # row = z-score per gene so each gene is comparable
    cluster_rows = FALSE,             # keep genes grouped by stage
    cluster_cols = FALSE,              # or FALSE to keep cluster order
    annotation_row = row_anno,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
    border_color = NA,
    main = title
  )
}

avg_heatmap(without_supercell, "RNA_snn_res.0.225", "Single-cell clusters")
avg_heatmap(merged, "RNA_snn_res.0.26", "Supercell clusters")

```

```{r}

res2 <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) {
  a <- objMarkers[objMarkers$cluster == pairs$single[i], c("gene", "avg_log2FC", "pct.1")]
  b <- scMarkers[scMarkers$cluster == pairs$super[i],  c("gene", "avg_log2FC", "pct.1")]
  m <- merge(a, b, by = "gene", suffixes = c("_single", "_super"))

  # same universe on both sides: expressed in both objects
  m <- m[m$pct.1_single > 0.25 & m$pct.1_super > 0.25, ]
  N <- nrow(m)
  ns <- c(50, 100, 200, 500)

  ov <- sapply(ns, function(n) {
    length(intersect(m$gene[order(-m$avg_log2FC_single)][1:n],
                     m$gene[order(-m$avg_log2FC_super)][1:n])) / n
  })
  fold_chance <- ov / (ns / N)        # 1 = random, higher = better

  # soft check: percentile of single-cell top 100 within the supercell ranking
  top_single <- m$gene[order(-m$avg_log2FC_single)][1:100]
  pct_rank   <- rank(m$avg_log2FC_super) / N
  mean_pctile <- mean(pct_rank[match(top_single, m$gene)])

  data.frame(single = pairs$single[i], super = pairs$super[i], N_universe = N,
             t(setNames(fold_chance, paste0("fold_chance_top", ns))),
             mean_pctile_top100 = mean_pctile)
})
do.call(rbind, res2)

```


```{r}

## HEATMAP FOR TOP 6 MARKERS 

make_marker_heatmaps <- function(markers, marker_prefix = "C", n_per_cluster = 6,
                                 source_label = "single-cell") {

  # only genes present in both objects
  shared <- intersect(rownames(without_supercell), rownames(merged))

  top <- markers |>
    filter(gene %in% shared, avg_log2FC > 0, pct.1 > 0.25) |>
    group_by(cluster) |>
    slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = n_per_cluster, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup() |>
    distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    arrange(as.numeric(as.character(cluster)), desc(avg_log2FC))

  genes <- top$gene
  row_group <- factor(paste0(marker_prefix, top$cluster, " markers"),
                      levels = unique(paste0(marker_prefix, top$cluster, " markers")))

  avg_z <- function(obj, group_by, prefix) {
    a <- AverageExpression(obj, features = genes, group.by = group_by,
                           assays = "RNA", layer = "data")$RNA
    a <- log1p(as.matrix(a))
    colnames(a) <- sub("^g", "", colnames(a))
    a <- a[genes, order(as.numeric(colnames(a))), drop = FALSE]
    z <- t(scale(t(a)))
    colnames(z) <- paste0(prefix, colnames(z))
    z
  }

  z1 <- avg_z(without_supercell, "RNA_snn_res.0.225", "C")
  z2 <- avg_z(merged,            "seurat_clusters",   "S")

  col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("navy", "white", "firebrick"))

  mk <- function(mat, title, first = FALSE) {
    Heatmap(
      mat, name = "Row z-score", col = col_fun,
      cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
      # marker blocks: split once, labeled on the left of the first panel only
      row_split = if (first) row_group else NULL,
      row_title_rot = 0, row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
      row_gap = unit(1.5, "mm"),
      show_row_names = first, row_names_side = "left",
      row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7, fontface = "italic"),
      # column labels
      column_title = title, column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
      column_names_rot = 0, column_names_centered = TRUE,
      column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
      border = TRUE, rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5),
      width = unit(ncol(mat) * 8, "mm"),
      heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Row z-score", at = c(-2, 0, 2),
                                  labels = c("low", "0", "high"))
    )
  }

  ht <- mk(z1, "Single cells\nsingle-cell clusters", first = TRUE) +
        mk(z2, "Supercells\nsupercell clusters")
  draw(ht,
       column_title = paste0("Top ", n_per_cluster, " markers per cluster (selected from ",
                             source_label, " data)"),
       column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
       heatmap_legend_side = "right", padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 8), "mm"))
}

# single-cell-derived markers (clusters labeled C0-C4)
make_marker_heatmaps(objMarkers, marker_prefix = "C", source_label = "single-cell")

# supercell-derived markers (clusters labeled S0-S4)
make_marker_heatmaps(scMarkers, marker_prefix = "S", source_label = "supercell")

```
